score_range_label.en: Moderate-High (62.8) — ATH confirmed, breadth diverging, NVDA catalyst tonight
score_range_label.zh: 中高确信度 (62.8) — ATH 确认，广度背离，今晚 NVDA 催化剂

position_advice.en: 63% (NVDA beat and rip = add to 70%. NVDA beat and drop = cut to 50%. Don't guess, let the market tell you)
position_advice.zh: 63%（NVDA beat and rip 加到 70%，beat and drop 砍到 50%。不猜，等市场告诉你）

summary.en: Liquidity continues to expand. Fed balance sheet +$19.0B WoW. TGA has released $168B from its $1.007T peak, down to $838.6B. Net liquidity has recovered +$165B from the April 22 bottom. Bank reserves at $3.117T. However, 30Y yield broke 5% for the first time since 2007, and Warsh's QT intentions remain the primary medium-term risk.
summary.zh: 流动性持续扩张。美联储资产负债表周环比 +$19.0B。TGA 从 $1.007T 峰值已释放 $168B，降至 $838.6B。净流动性从 4/22 底部回升 +$165B。银行准备金 $3.117T。然而，30Y 收益率突破 5%（2007 年以来首次），Warsh 缩表意图仍是主要中期风险。

details.en: Short-term liquidity metrics remain positive. TGA continues to release funds and the Fed balance sheet is expanding. However, the 30Y yield breaking 5% for the first time since 2007 signals that the bond market is pricing in fiscal unsustainability, sticky inflation, and Warsh QT expectations. A Forward P/E of 21x is difficult to sustain at 5% long rates. June FOMC remains the watershed moment.
details.zh: 短期流动性指标仍然积极。TGA 持续释放资金，美联储资产负债表在扩张。然而，30Y 收益率突破 5%（2007 年以来首次），表明债市在定价财政不可持续、通胀粘性和 Warsh 缩表预期。Forward P/E 21x 在 5% 长端利率下难以维持。6 月 FOMC 仍是分水岭。

status.zh: 扩张——30Y 破 5% 增加风险

reason.en: Fed expanding +$19B, TGA released $168B, bank reserves at $3.1T+. But Warsh QT threat and 30Y breaking 5% for the first time since 2007 discount the score.
reason.zh: 美联储扩表 +$19B，TGA 释放 $168B，银行准备金 $3.1T+。但 Warsh 缩表威胁 + 30Y 2007 年以来首次破 5% 打折。

status.en: Positive — Semis surging, NVDA reports tonight
status.zh: 正面——半导体爆发，今晚 NVDA 报告

reason.en: Q1 EPS +27.7% (strongest in 5 years), 84% beat rate. Semis surging: ARM +15%, AMD +8%, INTC +7%. NVDA reports tonight — the single most important catalyst this quarter.
reason.zh: Q1 EPS +27.7%（五年最强），84% beat rate。半导体爆发：ARM +15%，AMD +8%，INTC +7%。今晚 NVDA 报告——本季度最重要的单一催化剂。

reason.en: Only 50.69-52% above 200DMA. NYSE 797 advances vs 1964 declines on 5/19. Index at ATH while half the stocks are underwater. Narrow market driven by a handful of mega-cap tech stocks.
reason.zh: 仅 50.69-52% 在 200 日均线上方。5/19 当天 NYSE 797 涨 vs 1964 跌。指数 ATH 一半股票在水下。少数大型科技股驱动的窄市。

status.en: Positive — S&P and Nasdaq both at ATH, Russell leading
status.zh: 正面——S&P 和 Nasdaq 同创 ATH，Russell 领涨

reason.en: S&P 7,433 and Nasdaq 26,270 both at ATH. Russell 2000 +2.56% leading — breadth thrust signal. VIX 17.44 (-3.43%). Dow crossed 50,000. But 30Y at 5.12% is a structural warning.
reason.zh: S&P 7,433 和 Nasdaq 26,270 同创 ATH。Russell 2000 +2.56% 领涨——广度推力信号。VIX 17.44（-3.43%）。Dow 突破 50,000。但 30Y 5.12% 是结构性警告。

trading_summary.en: 62.8 — Moderate-High. Liquidity expanding, earnings accelerating, prices at ATH — three green lights simultaneously. Stay long. But breadth is lying — index at ATH while half the stocks are underwater. 30Y breaks 5% for first time since 2007, bond market and stock market telling different stories. NVDA tonight is the single most important catalyst. 63% position. NVDA beat and rip = add to 70%. NVDA beat and drop = cut to 50%. Don't guess, let the market tell you.
trading_summary.zh: 62.8分，Moderate-High。流动性扩张、盈利加速、价格创新高——三灯同时亮绿。做多。但广度在说谎——指数ATH一半股票在水下。30Y破5%是2007年以来首次，债市和股市在讲不同的故事。今晚NVDA是本季度最重要的单一催化剂。63%仓位。NVDA beat and rip加到70%，beat and drop砍到50%。不猜，等市场告诉你。

trading_quote: Three green lights: liquidity, earnings, price. But breadth is lying. 30Y breaks 5%. NVDA tonight decides.

note.en: Near ATH — central bank buying + geopolitical hedge
note.zh: 接近历史新高——央行囤金 + 地缘政治避险

exchange_flow_detail.en: YTD -30%, down 40% from $126K all-time high. Slight recovery but divergence from equity ATH persists.
exchange_flow_detail.zh: YTD -30%，从 $126K 历史高点跌 40%。小幅回升但与股市历史新高的背离持续。

analysis.en: BTC at $77,530 (+1.07%), a slight recovery. However, it remains down 40% from its $126K all-time high and -30% YTD. The BTC-equity divergence persists — equities at ATH while crypto is deeply underwater. This remains a key risk-off signal.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $77,530（+1.07%），小幅回升。然而，仍从 $126K 历史高点跌 40%，YTD -30%。BTC 与股市的背离持续——股市在 ATH 而加密深度亏损。这仍是关键的风险规避信号。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,546/oz, near extreme highs. Central bank accumulation continues and geopolitical safe-haven demand remains strong. Silver $76.16, Copper $6.33. Gold near ATH while equities also at ATH is a historically contradictory signal — the market is simultaneously pricing in growth and fear.
analysis.zh: 黄金报 $4,546/盎司，接近极端高位。央行持续囤金，地缘政治避险需求强烈。白银 $76.16，铜 $6.33。黄金接近历史新高而股市也在历史新高，是历史上矛盾的信号——市场同时在定价增长和恐惧。

detail.en: S&P at ATH but only 50-52% above 200DMA. NYSE 797 advances vs 1964 declines on 5/19. This is a narrow market driven by a handful of mega-cap tech stocks. Index at ATH while half the stocks are underwater is a classic late-cycle warning.
detail.zh: S&P 在 ATH 但仅 50-52% 在 200 日均线上方。5/19 当天 NYSE 797 涨 vs 1964 跌。少数大型科技股驱动的窄市。指数 ATH 一半股票在水下，是经典的周期末期警告。

detail.en: 30Y yield at 5.12%, breaking 5% for the first time since 2007. Bond market is pricing fiscal unsustainability, sticky inflation, and Warsh QT expectations. A Forward P/E of 21x cannot hold at 5% long rates. The bond market and stock market are telling different stories.
detail.zh: 30Y 收益率 5.12%，突破 5%（2007 年以来首次）。债市在定价财政不可持续 + 通胀粘性 + Warsh 缩表预期。Forward P/E 21x 在 5% 长端利率下站不住。债市和股市在讲不同的故事。

title.en: NVDA reports tonight — expectations extremely high
title.zh: NVDA 今晚盘后报告——预期极高

detail.en: NVDA reports tonight — the single most important catalyst this quarter. ARM +15%, AMD +8%, INTC +7% have set expectations extremely high. Beat and rip = add to 70%. Beat and drop = cut to 50%. The risk is asymmetric: upside is limited (already priced in), downside could be significant.
detail.zh: NVDA 今晚盘后报告——本季度最重要的单一催化剂。ARM +15%、AMD +8%、INTC +7% 已将预期推到极高。Beat and rip 加仓到 70%，beat and drop 砍到 50%。风险不对称：上行有限（已定价），下行可能显著。

title.en: Active. S&P ATH + breadth 50-52% (divergence). Equities ATH + BTC -30% YTD (divergence). Equities ATH + Gold ATH (contradiction). 30Y breaks 5% + equities ATH (bond-equity contradiction).
title.zh: 活跃。S&P ATH + 广度 50-52%（背离）。股市 ATH + BTC -30% YTD（背离）。股市 ATH + Gold ATH（矛盾）。30Y 破 5% + 股市 ATH（债股矛盾）。

detail.en: Multiple divergences active simultaneously. S&P and Nasdaq at ATH but breadth is only 50-52% and the advance-decline line is negative. Equities at ATH while BTC is -30% YTD. Gold and equities both near ATH — historically contradictory. 30Y breaking 5% while equities are at ATH is a bond-equity contradiction that historically resolves with equities moving lower.
detail.zh: 多个背离同时活跃。S&P 和 Nasdaq 在 ATH 但广度仅 50-52%，涨跌线为负。股市在 ATH 而 BTC YTD -30%。黄金和股市同时接近历史新高——历史上矛盾。30Y 破 5% 而股市在 ATH，是债股矛盾，历史上通常以股市下跌解决。
